app.name: Unhoard
app.tagline: See where your disk space went, and get it back safely.

map.keys: Cell map. Arrow keys move between cells, Enter zooms in, Backspace goes up, the Menu key opens the actions.
map.empty: Scan a drive to see where your space went.

details.unreadable: This folder could not be read without admin rights. Its size is unknown.
details.generic: A large item Unhoard has no explanation for. Only you can judge whether you still need it.
details.cloudState: {{local}} on this PC · {{cloud}} in the cloud
details.requiresAdmin: Needs admin rights, so Unhoard points you to the Windows tool.
details.nothing: Select an item to see what it is.

preview.title: Preview: nothing has changed yet
preview.notFreed: On the same drive this frees nothing yet: the space comes back after 30 days, or when you delete the items yourself.
preview.freeNote: Files become online-only. Nothing is deleted and nothing is downloaded.

reasons.changed: changed since the scan; scan again
reasons.insideSelection: already part of a selected folder

quarantine.title: Quarantine
quarantine.intro: Everything you move waits here for 30 days. Restore puts it back exactly where it was.
quarantine.restoredAs: Restored as {{name}}, because the original name is in use.

cloud.title: Cloud
cloud.none: No cloud folders were found on this PC.
cloud.scanFirst: Scan the drive that holds your cloud folder first.

photos.title: Photos & videos
photos.analyzing: Looking at your photos… nothing is downloaded.
photos.keys: Arrows move · Space selects · Enter moves · N next group

settings.title: Settings
settings.privacy: Unhoard makes no network connections and sends nothing anywhere.
settings.license: Free software under the GNU GPL, version 3 or later.

firstRun.title: Where did your space go?
firstRun.body: Unhoard maps your drive, explains every big item and helps you clear what you do not need. It never deletes anything without you, and everything you move can be restored for 30 days.
firstRun.privacy: Everything stays on this PC. No account, no network.

errors.staleScan: This view is out of date. Scan again.
errors.unknownItem: This item is no longer there. Scan again.
errors.invalidArgument: That did not work. Try again.
errors.busy: Wait until the scan has finished.

fs.locked: It is in use by another program. Close that program and try again.
fs.alreadyExists: Something with that name already exists.
fs.changed: It changed since the scan, so Unhoard left it alone. Scan again.

companion.name: Lumen
companion.drag: Drag to move, click for earlier messages

firstRun: Hi, I'm Lumen. I'll explain what you see, in bubbles like this one. Never in a popup.
scanStart: I'm scanning {{drive}} now. I only look; I change nothing.
scanProgress: {{files}} files counted. The big blocks are already showing.
scanDone: Done. The three largest: {{top}}. Click a cell to zoom in.
hiddenSpace: The striped cell is hidden space: {{size}} in use that the scan could not see, such as restore points. Click it to find out more.
revealDeclined: No problem. Without admin rights that part stays unknown, and nothing else changes.
revealDone: Revealed {{size}}. Most of it is usually restore points; manage those in System Protection.

safe: {{name}} is a cache: it is rebuilt by itself. Safe to move to the quarantine.
likelySafe: You probably no longer need {{name}}. From the quarantine you can restore it for 30 days.
review: Only you know whether you still need {{name}}. Have a look before you decide.
keep: {{name}} belongs to Windows or an app. Don't remove it by hand; the right Windows tool does it safely.
protected: {{name}} is a protected location. I explain it, but I never move it.

previewShown: First a preview, so you see exactly what will happen. Nothing has changed yet.
quarantineMoved: Moved to the quarantine. Note: not freed yet. I'll delete it after 30 days, and warn you first.

5: In 5 days I'll delete the batch from {{date}} ({{size}}). Restore anything you still want.
3: In 3 days I'll delete the batch from {{date}} ({{size}}).
1: Tomorrow I'll delete the batch from {{date}} ({{size}}). Last chance to restore.

deleteEarly: Want the space now? Open the folder, select the items and press Shift+Delete, or press Delete and empty the Recycle Bin.
restored: Put back exactly where it was.
freeUpSpaceDone: {{size}} is online-only now. It stays safe in the cloud.
photoReview: Each group starts with nothing selected. 'Select all but the keeper' keeps the best shot.
photoNoThumbs: Some cloud photos have no cached preview. I group those by name, size and date only, so nothing is downloaded.
windowsTool: I'm opening the Windows tool. That's the safe place to clean this up.
zoomTip: Backspace or the breadcrumb takes you back up.
cloudIntro: These files are also in the cloud. Free up space makes them online-only, without downloading or deleting anything.

adobe-media-cache.title: Adobe media cache
adobe-media-cache.explain: Preview files Premiere Pro and other Adobe apps made of your footage.
adobe-media-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

amd-dxcache.title: AMD DirectX cache
amd-dxcache.explain: Shaders the AMD driver prepared for games.
amd-dxcache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

android-emulators.title: Android emulators
android-emulators.explain: Virtual Android phones of Android Studio.
android-emulators.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.
android-emulators.action: Remove emulators you no longer use in the Device Manager of Android Studio.

android-sdk.title: Android SDK
android-sdk.explain: Android platforms, system images and tools.
android-sdk.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.
android-sdk.action: Remove old platforms in the SDK Manager of Android Studio.

battlenet.title: Battle.net
battlenet.explain: Games installed with Battle.net. Games often take tens of gigabytes each.
battlenet.reason: Only you know which games you still play.
battlenet.action: Uninstall games through Battle.net, so it stays consistent. Unhoard never moves a game folder.

brave-cache.title: Brave cache
brave-cache.explain: Web pages and images Brave saved to load sites faster.
brave-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

cargo-git.title: Cargo git checkouts
cargo-git.explain: Packages Cargo downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
cargo-git.reason: Cargo downloads them again when needed.

cargo-registry.title: Cargo registry
cargo-registry.explain: Packages Cargo downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
cargo-registry.reason: Cargo downloads them again when needed.

chrome-cache.title: Chrome cache
chrome-cache.explain: Web pages and images Chrome saved to load sites faster. Bookmarks and passwords are elsewhere.
chrome-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

chrome-code-cache.title: Chrome code cache
chrome-code-cache.explain: Compiled website scripts Chrome keeps to start sites faster.
chrome-code-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

chrome-gpu-cache.title: Chrome graphics cache
chrome-gpu-cache.explain: Graphics shaders Chrome prepared for your video card.
chrome-gpu-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

crash-dumps.title: App crash dumps
crash-dumps.explain: Crash reports that apps saved when they stopped unexpectedly.
crash-dumps.reason: Only useful to report those crashes.

d3d-shader-cache.title: DirectX shader cache
d3d-shader-cache.explain: Graphics shaders Windows prepared for games and apps.
d3d-shader-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

delivery-optimization.title: Delivery Optimization files
delivery-optimization.explain: Update files Windows shares with other PCs to save bandwidth.
delivery-optimization.reason: Only a cache for sharing updates.
delivery-optimization.action: Clean it with Disk Cleanup › Delivery Optimization Files.

discord-cache.title: Discord cache
discord-cache.explain: Images and media Discord saved from your chats.
discord-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

docker-disk.title: Docker Desktop disk
docker-disk.explain: Images, containers and volumes of Docker Desktop.
docker-disk.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.
docker-disk.action: Run docker system prune, then compact the disk in Docker Desktop.

dotnet-bin.title: .NET build output
dotnet-bin.explain: Build output of a .NET project (found next to its .csproj).
dotnet-bin.reason: It can be rebuilt with dotnet build.

dotnet-obj.title: .NET intermediate files
dotnet-obj.explain: Intermediate build files of a .NET project.
dotnet-obj.reason: It can be rebuilt with dotnet build.

downloads-extracted-zip.title: Already extracted archive
downloads-extracted-zip.explain: A ZIP file whose extracted folder is right next to it.
downloads-extracted-zip.reason: The content is already in the folder next to it.
downloads-extracted-zip.action: Move the ZIP to the quarantine.

downloads-iso.title: Disc images
downloads-iso.explain: ISO files: copies of installation discs or other disks.
downloads-iso.reason: Only you know whether you still need it.
downloads-iso.action: Check it, then move it to the quarantine.

downloads-old-installers.title: Old installers
downloads-old-installers.explain: Installers you downloaded more than a month ago. The programs are usually installed already, and you can download them again.
downloads-old-installers.reason: You can usually download them again.

driver-store.title: Driver store
driver-store.explain: Every driver Windows has installed, so it can reinstall them.
driver-store.reason: Windows needs it for your hardware.

ea-games.title: EA games
ea-games.explain: Games installed with the EA app. Games often take tens of gigabytes each.
ea-games.reason: Only you know which games you still play.
ea-games.action: Uninstall games through the EA app, so it stays consistent. Unhoard never moves a game folder.

edge-cache.title: Edge cache
edge-cache.explain: Web pages and images Edge saved to load sites faster. Favourites and passwords are elsewhere.
edge-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

edge-code-cache.title: Edge code cache
edge-code-cache.explain: Compiled website scripts Edge keeps to start sites faster.
edge-code-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

epic-games.title: Epic Games
epic-games.explain: Games installed with the Epic Games Launcher. Games often take tens of gigabytes each.
epic-games.reason: Only you know which games you still play.
epic-games.action: Uninstall games through the Epic Games Launcher, so it stays consistent. Unhoard never moves a game folder.

firefox-cache.title: Firefox cache
firefox-cache.explain: Web pages and images Firefox saved to load sites faster. Bookmarks and passwords are elsewhere.
firefox-cache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

gradle-caches.title: Gradle caches
gradle-caches.explain: Packages Gradle downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
gradle-caches.reason: Gradle downloads them again when needed.

hiberfil.title: Hibernation file
hiberfil.explain: Windows writes your memory here for hibernate and Fast Startup. Its size follows your RAM.
hiberfil.reason: Windows needs it while hibernation is on.
hiberfil.action: To make it smaller, run powercfg /h /type reduced as administrator. That also affects Fast Startup.

huggingface-cache.title: Hugging Face models
huggingface-cache.explain: AI models downloaded by Hugging Face tools.
huggingface-cache.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.

hyperv-disks.title: Hyper-V virtual disk
hyperv-disks.explain: The disk of a Hyper-V virtual machine.
hyperv-disks.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.
hyperv-disks.action: Remove machines you no longer need in Hyper-V Manager.

maven-repository.title: Maven repository
maven-repository.explain: Packages Maven downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
maven-repository.reason: Maven downloads them again when needed.

memory-dump.title: Crash memory dump
memory-dump.explain: A full copy of memory from the last system crash, for troubleshooting.
memory-dump.reason: Only useful to analyse that crash.
memory-dump.action: Remove it with Disk Cleanup › System error memory dump files.

minidump.title: Crash minidumps
minidump.explain: Small crash reports from earlier system crashes.
minidump.reason: Only useful to analyse those crashes.

node-modules.title: node_modules
node-modules.explain: The installed packages of a JavaScript project (found next to its package.json).
node-modules.reason: It can be rebuilt with npm install.

npm-cache.title: npm cache
npm-cache.explain: Packages npm downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
npm-cache.reason: npm downloads them again when needed.

nuget-http-cache.title: NuGet HTTP cache
nuget-http-cache.explain: Packages NuGet downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
nuget-http-cache.reason: NuGet downloads them again when needed.

nuget-packages.title: NuGet packages
nuget-packages.explain: Packages NuGet downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
nuget-packages.reason: NuGet downloads them again when needed.

nvidia-dxcache.title: NVIDIA DirectX cache
nvidia-dxcache.explain: Shaders the NVIDIA driver prepared for DirectX games.
nvidia-dxcache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

nvidia-glcache.title: NVIDIA OpenGL cache
nvidia-glcache.explain: Shaders the NVIDIA driver prepared for OpenGL apps.
nvidia-glcache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

ollama-models.title: Ollama models
ollama-models.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.

package-cache.title: Installer package cache
package-cache.explain: Installers that programs need to repair or uninstall themselves.
package-cache.reason: Without it programs cannot be repaired or removed.

pagefile.title: Page file
pagefile.explain: Virtual memory: Windows uses it when RAM runs low and for crash dumps.
pagefile.reason: Windows needs it, also with plenty of RAM.
pagefile.action: Leave it alone. Never turn the page file off.

phone-backup-apple-devices.title: iPhone backup (Apple Devices)
phone-backup-apple-devices.explain: A full backup of an iPhone or iPad made by the Apple Devices app.
phone-backup-apple-devices.reason: Only you know whether you have a newer backup.
phone-backup-apple-devices.action: Check you have a newer backup, then move it to the quarantine.

phone-backup-itunes.title: iPhone backup (iTunes)
phone-backup-itunes.explain: A full backup of an iPhone or iPad made by iTunes.
phone-backup-itunes.reason: Only you know whether you have a newer backup.
phone-backup-itunes.action: Check you have a newer backup, then move it to the quarantine.

pip-cache.title: pip cache
pip-cache.explain: Packages pip downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
pip-cache.reason: pip downloads them again when needed.

pnpm-store.title: pnpm store
pnpm-store.explain: Packages pnpm downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
pnpm-store.reason: pnpm downloads them again when needed.

python-venv.title: Python virtual environment
python-venv.explain: The installed packages of a Python project.
python-venv.reason: It can be rebuilt with pip install -r requirements.txt.

recycle-bin.title: Recycle Bin
recycle-bin.explain: Files you already deleted. They take space until the Recycle Bin is emptied.
recycle-bin.reason: You already chose to delete them.
recycle-bin.action: Check it, then empty the Recycle Bin.

rust-target.title: Rust build folder
rust-target.explain: Build output of a Rust project (found next to its Cargo.toml).
rust-target.reason: It can be rebuilt with cargo build.

steam-games.title: Steam games
steam-games.explain: Games installed with Steam. Games often take tens of gigabytes each.
steam-games.reason: Only you know which games you still play.
steam-games.action: Uninstall games through Steam, so it stays consistent. Unhoard never moves a game folder.

steam-shadercache.title: Steam shader cache
steam-shadercache.explain: Shaders Steam prepared for your games. Steam rebuilds them when you play.
steam-shadercache.reason: The app rebuilds it by itself. Close the app first.

swapfile.title: Swap file
swapfile.explain: A small helper file Windows uses for apps from the Store.

system-volume-information.title: Restore points
system-volume-information.explain: Restore points and shadow copies that let Windows undo system changes.
system-volume-information.reason: Deleting them blindly removes your safety net.
system-volume-information.action: Manage them in System Protection: choose how much space they may use, or delete old ones.

thumbnail-cache.title: Thumbnail cache
thumbnail-cache.explain: Small previews Explorer made of your pictures and videos.
thumbnail-cache.reason: Explorer makes them again when needed.
thumbnail-cache.action: Clean it with Disk Cleanup › Thumbnails.

ubisoft-games.title: Ubisoft games
ubisoft-games.explain: Games installed with Ubisoft Connect. Games often take tens of gigabytes each.
ubisoft-games.reason: Only you know which games you still play.
ubisoft-games.action: Uninstall games through Ubisoft Connect, so it stays consistent. Unhoard never moves a game folder.

update-downloads.title: Windows Update downloads
update-downloads.explain: Update files Windows already installed or still has to install.
update-downloads.reason: Windows downloads them again when needed.
update-downloads.action: Clean it with Disk Cleanup › Clean up system files › Windows Update Cleanup.

user-temp.title: Your temporary files
user-temp.explain: Apps leave temporary files here and often forget to clean them up.
user-temp.reason: Apps recreate what they need. Files in use are skipped.
user-temp.action: Let Storage Sense clean it, or clean it with Disk Cleanup.

virtualbox-vms.title: VirtualBox machine
virtualbox-vms.explain: A VirtualBox virtual machine with its disks.
virtualbox-vms.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.
virtualbox-vms.action: Remove machines you no longer need in VirtualBox.

vmware-vms.title: VMware machine
vmware-vms.explain: A VMware virtual machine with its disks.
vmware-vms.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.
vmware-vms.action: Remove machines you no longer need in VMware.

windows-installer.title: Windows Installer cache
windows-installer.explain: Copies of installers Windows needs to repair, update or remove your programs.
windows-installer.reason: Without it programs cannot be repaired or removed.
windows-installer.action: Leave it alone. Remove programs you no longer use in Settings › Apps.

windows-old.title: Previous Windows installation
windows-old.explain: A copy of your previous Windows, kept after an upgrade so you can go back. Windows removes it after about 10 days, or you can remove it yourself.
windows-old.reason: Only needed to roll back an upgrade.
windows-old.action: Remove it with Disk Cleanup › Previous Windows installation(s).

windows-temp.title: Windows temporary files
windows-temp.explain: Temporary files of Windows and installers.
windows-temp.action: Clean it with Disk Cleanup › Clean up system files.

winsxs.title: Windows component store
winsxs.explain: Holds the Windows components and updates. Explorer shows it larger than it is, because many files are hard links shared with System32.
winsxs.reason: Removing files by hand breaks Windows Update and repairs.
winsxs.action: Disk Cleanup cleans old components safely, or run DISM /Online /Cleanup-Image /StartComponentCleanup.

wsl-disk.title: WSL Linux disk
wsl-disk.explain: The virtual disk of a Linux distribution in WSL. It grows as you use it, but never shrinks by itself.
wsl-disk.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.
wsl-disk.action: Clean up inside Linux, then compact the disk (wsl --manage <distro> --set-sparse true, or Optimize-VHD).

wsl-disk-store.title: WSL Linux disk
wsl-disk-store.explain: The virtual disk of a Linux distribution in WSL. It grows as you use it, but never shrinks by itself.
wsl-disk-store.reason: It holds your data in one big file or folder.
wsl-disk-store.action: Clean up inside Linux, then compact the disk.

xbox-games.title: Xbox games
xbox-games.explain: Games installed with the Xbox app. Games often take tens of gigabytes each.
xbox-games.reason: Only you know which games you still play.
xbox-games.action: Uninstall games through the Xbox app, so it stays consistent. Unhoard never moves a game folder.

yarn-cache.title: Yarn cache
yarn-cache.explain: Packages Yarn downloaded once, kept to install them faster next time.
yarn-cache.reason: Yarn downloads them again when needed.
